value:
THE RUN-40 CLOSE-LANE CANDIDATE TABLE, ranked as AGENTS.md requires (records-per-unmatched-function, not fuzzy), measured at commit b2876d6bc and re-measured after each landing. METHOD: `nearmiss.py --min 95 --parked skip --residuals` for the ranking by measured `real`, `gdlmem context <fn>` on every candidate BEFORE choosing it, `gdlmem claims` to veto the TUs owned by SA/SB/MV/CT (game/game/player, game/enemy/enemy, game/enemy/critter, game/movie/movieplayer, and game/audio/sndfx-adjacent schedule rows), and the per-TU webfrank pin list read from config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json before ranking anything by measured real.

CHOSEN AND WORKED, six: adsInitFromHeader (game/audio/adstream, 1 record, 0 pins in TU, real 16) CLOSED BYTE-EXACT/STRICT; next_rune_hint (game/ui/options, 2 records, open 10b hypothesis, real 18) CLOSED EXACT at EQUIVALENT tier; CamLimitPlayerDpos (game/boss/bosscam, ZERO records, 0 pins, real 36) IMPROVED, fuzzy 95.0000 -> 95.1788; pbDiagDrawMenu (game/pb/pb_diag, ZERO records, real 28) IMPROVED, fuzzy 96.9858 -> 98.0851; towerRecordLevelBeaten (game/world/tower, 1 record, real 48) CAPPED; update_player_milestone (game/world/items, ZERO records, real 46) CAPPED; sndFxQueAddEx (game/audio/sndfx, 1 record, real 12) CAPPED. The ranking rule paid: the three ZERO-record functions produced two of the run's four score movements, and the two lowest-`real` rows in the whole table (sndFxQueAddEx at 12 and next_rune_hint at 18) were the two with the thickest prior records - exactly the inversion AGENTS.md warns about.

SKIPPED, with the reason each time: PointLineColl (worldcol, capped 2026-09-01 with a typed do-not-retry naming every operand-association, declaration-order, comma-sequencing and storage-class axis as spent, and routed to the postprocessor); ControllerMessageBox and StringTextWidthSub's TU (game/ui/screensaver, game/ui/btext) left alone because work_claim.sched-census-t2.20260902.v1's scope is rows 5-10 of the run-39 schedule census by mnemonic-divergence ascending and those rows land in screensaver/btext/mb_particle/sounds - the claim names only its flagship, so the conservative reading was taken; allocPsys (capped run 36 on four distinct lfsu spellings with the mechanism named as a peephole fusion choice on a base whose update has no other consumer); LoadPdataFile (deferred, see below); every game/game/player, game/enemy/enemy, game/enemy/critter and game/movie/movieplayer row (foreign active claims).

THE ACTIONABLE RESIDUE, and it is a DEMAND CENSUS for a class that already ships. The LIVE-ZERO VALUE class (webfrank `equivalent_zero_form`, proof `zero_value_dataflow`) closed four functions on 2026-09-02 - DrawStringTextMLines, FontInit, FindStringMessageListSub_8001FC4C and init_all_dir_info - and claim.law.live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source.20260831.v1 carries its class-level source-unreachability proof across twelve functions in eight TUs. TWO further customers were measured live this run and neither has been served:
  game/sfx/psfx::LoadPdataFile - 88/88, ONE ops cluster, opcode multiset '+1 addi / -1 li', RAW DIFFERING WORDS = 17 of 88, real 32. The live-zero word is at +0x118: ours `li r29,0` (3ba00000) against the target's `addi r28,r23,0` (3b970000). The other 16 words are a callee-saved recolor, so a close needs equivalent_zero_form COMPOSED with copy_register_fields and the recolor's consistency has not been proved. Source provenance already exists: attempt.loadpdatafile-record-alias-closure.20260829.v1 lists the zero-copy, scope, explicit-base, typed-header and offset/sizePtr axes as spent.
  game/pb/pb_diag::pbDiagDrawMenu - 141/141, RAW DIFFERING WORDS = 18 of 141 after this run's source work, live-zero word at +0x118 (ours `li r25,0` 3b200000 against target `addi r25,r26,0` 3b3a0000, declared_zero_register 26). Needs a FOUR-stage composed rule; the full decomposition is in attempt.NM_pbdiagdrawmenu-scoped-opt-propagation-plus-materialised-row.20260902.v1 together with a source hypothesis that may remove one of the two permutation stages first.
Neither is a new capability request: the class exists, is guarded, and has published rule shapes to copy in game/ui/btext.

A MEASUREMENT WORTH REUSING, and the reason the FPR-allocation theory did not become a lane: screening all 229 `nearmiss.py --min 90` rows (foreign-claimed TUs excluded) for a residual whose every differing LINE is an FPR renaming and nothing else returns exactly TWO functions, adsInitFromHeader (closed) and PointLineColl (capped). A pure-FPR-rotation harvest lane does not exist; the screen itself costs one scripted pass over existing objects with no build.
